subject: SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1094 (landed). Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.7.4 "a delimiter shall directly follow the data described with dynamic-length-structure-name-1" -> OK 12.3.7.4 19)): with DELIMITED a delimiter - one alphanumeric (national) character of zero bits - follows the data. A record that holds a member naming a DELIMITED structure now has it on the medium: the record has a contiguous form (the data alone, 8.5.1.11.2) and a medium form (each structured member as [length field][data][delimiter]), made in ONE place by CobolContiguousLayout.MediumImage / MediumExtents and read back by Decompose over the per-member CobolDynStructure. Witnessed from a SECOND description of the same file (a dynamic-length record with no structure) whose characters are the file's: AB -> 65 66 0, an empty item -> 0, a national record AB -> 0 65 0 66 0 0 (the delimiter is a national character, two bytes), both phrases -> length field, data, delimiter. The round trip through the typed description returns every member (D1=AB, D2=CDE) in every organization and the sort; sizes count the structure (FileModel.MaxDynamicExtent / MinExtent). D-DL3 (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3) rewritten: the item is in the record, the program never sees the structure bytes, and a LINE SEQUENTIAL WRITE of such a record is the 71 of 14.9.51.4 GR23.
